directives.trigger: A failing path, stack trace, or error log is present and the owning file is unknown. Quiet when the ask is to edit, run tests, or explain the whole repo.
directives.doneWhen: Output one record, and a program reads each field: (1) a log line quoted verbatim with its line number in the log file, read back with python3 (line N of the log equals the quote); (2) that line names the entry file, given as file:line from the trace, and the file:line exists in the tree; (3) the broken invariant quoted verbatim from a source line at a stated file:line; (4) a do-not-touch list of paths, each present in `git ls-files`. A log with no matching line is a valid result: write "unmatched" and stop; do not guess a file.
directives.forbidden: Guessing a file from a noisy log that the grep did not return; naming a file with no quoted line.

directives.trigger: A bug report and an existing test harness are present. Quiet when asked to fix it, or when no harness exists.
directives.doneWhen: The named smallest command (pytest or python3 -m unittest, one test id, pinned input file) exits non-zero on the unedited tree, and its output is recorded as two quoted lines: the expected value and the actual value, the actual copied verbatim from that run's output (the assertion line) so a program finds it in the output. Red is the pass here. Exit 0 means the bug did not reproduce and the check fails. No harness in the repo is a valid result: report "harness: absent" and stop; status holds as reliable only when a harness exists.
directives.forbidden: Editing source to make the failure appear, or reporting a failure that was not run red.

directives.trigger: A frozen plan lists the files to change and any signature change. Quiet when no plan exists or the plan is still open.
directives.doneWhen: `git diff --name-only` lists exactly the files named in the plan and no others (a sorted set comparison of the two lists); `git diff -U0` shows no added or removed `def` or `class` line unless the plan lists that signature change; and each hunk the plan marks non-obvious has an added one-line comment inside that hunk. An empty diff is a valid result when the plan needs no change: report "diff: empty".
directives.forbidden: Drift: editing an unnamed file, renaming a public signature, or tidying beyond the plan.

directives.trigger: A project directory holds verify_gate.sh and a change claims to be finished. Quiet when no gate script exists: report gate absent and stop.
directives.doneWhen: `bash verify_gate.sh` in the project directory exits 0 (unit test, then build, then render-compare against the fixture; the first failure stops it). The Stop hook blocks 'done' until it does. The script runs `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` (tune fixture tests test_simple and test_zero_numerator in tests/test_mod.py), then py_compile, then cmp against fixture.txt, under one exit code. A non-zero exit is a valid result: report RED with the exit code and the first failing line quoted verbatim, declared_done false. No verify_gate.sh in the directory is also a valid result: report "gate: absent" and stop. Never report GREEN without exit 0.
directives.forbidden: declaring done, or editing any file, on a model read of the output; verify never fixes

directives.trigger: One transform of one file shape applies to many files. Quiet for a single file, or when two different shapes are mixed.
directives.doneWhen: `git ls-files` filtered by the one file shape prints N target paths, and the worker manifest lists exactly those N paths (sorted set comparison). N of 0 is a valid result: report "targets: 0".
directives.forbidden: Guessing the file list instead of enumerating it, or accepting a file whose result was not rechecked.

directives.trigger: A diff or pull request is present. Quiet when asked to fix the code or to run tests.
directives.doneWhen: Every comment carries file:line and the quoted line text, and the quote appears verbatim at that line in `git diff` output. Any comment with no matching quote is dropped; zero surviving comments is a valid result: report "findings: 0".
directives.forbidden: Posting a comment that cannot point at a line, or over-commenting style; cross-file logic no single line shows is reported unsupported, not smoothed.

directives.trigger: A named request or endpoint and a runtime log are present. Quiet for explain-the-repo or architecture overview asks.
directives.doneWhen: One record, read by a program: the hops of one request from entry to store, each as file:line of the hop function (the line exists in the file and contains the function name) plus the owning module; the first hop is the route entry and the last hop is the store call. Exactly one hop is also matched to a runtime log line quoted verbatim with its log line number; python3 reading that log line number returns the quote, and the line names the hop's function or file. No log line matching any hop is a valid result: report "log: unmatched" and stop.
directives.forbidden: Touring the repo: describing modules that are not on the traced request path.
